ABOUT / PETER IDINGAALSO KNOWN AS GREGZTECH
Peter
Idinga.Find me on LinkedIn ↗

I like figuring out
how things work.
Then making them work.

I’m a full-stack software engineer. I work on the interfaces people interact with, the logic behind them, and the data moving between the two.

Some projects need a clear, well-built website. Others need more: accounts, permissions, payments, or workflows that bring several people together. I enjoy connecting those pieces into one usable product.

CEAVOX, HearIntel and QPrep are full-stack projects I’ve worked on. My contribution to Safe Nest is frontend development.
